# Lawplain judgment directory

> 10,614 public ruling identifiers from the corpus sitemap snapshot. Each directory links to original ruling text in Markdown.

This directory is regenerated with the corpus sitemaps. Coverage is not exhaustive of all Singapore decisions. Long documents have explicit text ranges and continuation links.
